'''Coruscant Health Officials''' were officials of the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Coruscant Health Office/Legends|Health Administration]] that specialized in monitoring the health of [[Coruscanti/Legends|the citizens]] of that [[Planet/Legends|world]]. They estimated that millions of children abused [[Death stick/Legends|death sticks]].
